decisions.hypothesis: The binding limitation on this frozen reach-and-hold task is hold-window tip speed (residual kinetic energy at the held configuration), not reach accuracy or static force feasibility: historical development passes at ~0.00728 m/s and the one retained historical confirmation failure was 0.047411 m/s with position still inside tolerance (artifact 9aee575b). The only configuration with direct task-level pass evidence under this identical frozen task (task_identity 2b26edb4...) and this identical non-timed research_work_v1 recipe is the softened distal1 segment (selected_young_pa distal1 = 4.86e6 Pa = 0.9x nominal, near at baseline 7.2e6 Pa, nominal lengths/sections/routing, holding and terminal tip-speed weights 0.10), which passed 2/2 fresh non-timed confirmations at holding_max_speed 0.017345 m/s (artifact 3eb3970e). Therefore a candidate whose only declared-parameter deviation from the reference is segments.distal1.young_pa = 4.86e6 Pa (within this study's declared bound [4590000, 6209999.999]) is the single best-supported immutable configuration to carry into a fresh backend execution in this study.

decisions.hypothesis: No admissible execution is possible with the candidates that already exist, and the tool feedback says why: 10995b7a aborts before launch with an adapter TypeError, 5c227241 is refused with OLD_EVALUATION_PROFILE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_NEW_CONSTRUCTION, and the only current-profile object, 9ba1c986, is spent with an inadmissible package (its internal evaluator run was valid and reported position_error 0.0031197439682656434 m against the 0.01 m bound with task_success true, but the execution is stamped execution_incomplete at the profile packaging stage by the defect "name 'report_configuration' is not defined"). A new construction is therefore the only route left. Two independent evidence lines fix what it should be. First, the only direct task-level pass on this exact frozen task under this exact non-timed research_work_v1 recipe is the compliant distal1 material (young_pa 4.86e6, i.e. 0.9x nominal) with nominal geometry and weights 0.10/0.10, which passed 2/2 fresh non-timed confirmations in study feedback-design-20261014, whereas the retained hold-window speed failure belonged to a different (section-scaled) candidate under a timed policy that is disabled here. Second, this study's own preflight on the now-unexecutable candidate 5c227241 indicated that near-segment length 0.162 m with semi_y 0.0096 m, together with distal1 section-1 width 0.0115 m, gave the largest held-position authority measured in this study (min eigenvalue 124.5) and a target-associated static equilibrium solved to 2.456e-9 m under bounded tensions. Fixing distal1 at the historically validated compliant value while adopting that supported geometry yields a genuinely new immutable configuration with the best-supported expectation of meeting the frozen task's position bound.
decisions.interpretation: A proposal is configuration definition only. It establishes no pass, no holding margin, no damping, no improvement and no structural superiority, and it cannot satisfy selection by itself. The held-position Gramian and the static equilibrium residual are model-side selection aids that the protocol declares not to be damping or holding certificates, so they are used here only to choose which new configuration to build and never as acceptance evidence. Acceptance still requires a fresh complete backend execution package, whose exact reference must be publicly read before selection.
decisions.stopping_condition: Submit exactly one new-construction candidate. If the returned artifact is genuinely new and admitted, stop proposing and proceed to one contained execution. If it is rejected, or if it returns an already-existing artifact (shared identity with 10995b7a or 5c227241), do not resubmit unchanged science: make at most one further justified change or proceed to STOP.

decisions.hypothesis: No admissible evidence of task success is obtainable in this study under the frozen task, recipe and declared bounds, which is why it is sealed without a selection. The complete record of new results, each cited below: (1) the engineering preflight on candidate d8e0320c is execution_incomplete — the worker failed before complete calculation records were published and its reservation and attempt remain charged (15.08 s); (2) the engineering preflight on candidate 5c227241 computed, reporting held_position_min_eigenvalue 124.5188210574333 and target_equilibrium_residual 2.456374264008673e-09 m from a bounded static SLSQP construction (status 0, 16 iterations) with a companion CasADi/SciPy scaled Van Loan and ZOH linearization; (3) executing the old-profile compliant candidate 10995b7a aborted before launch with an adapter TypeError, so no worker started and no result exists; (4) the proposal plan dedc436d defining that compliant configuration returned the already-existing artifact 10995b7a rather than a new construction; (5) executing the current-profile reference candidate 9ba1c986 (plan c773f543) produced execution 20c4b4f8 and result artifact 3bfd4da5 with status execution_incomplete: simulation.run completed (solver_status completed, 3321.03 s wall, backend_solves 1, output BackendResult d9d50700) and evaluation.run completed (validity valid, task_success true, position_error 0.0031197439682656434 m against the 0.01 m task bound, output EvaluationResult a304c279), but the run is stamped incomplete at stage "profile" because control.profile_report failed with "name 'report_configuration' is not defined", leaving metrics, task_performance and acceptance null; (6) the earlier recorded result ca6789a8 for candidate 10995b7a is complete false, passed false, task_performance unmeasured, 0.086 s, and additionally carries OLD_EVALUATION_PROFILE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_NEW_CONSTRUCTION; (7) executing the old-profile proxy-favoured candidate 5c227241 was refused with OLD_EVALUATION_PROFILE_CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_NEW_CONSTRUCTION; (8) the new-construction proposal plan 4c63b96b returned candidate b364513b, whose execution was then refused with CANDIDATE_PLUS_DECLARED_CONFIRMATIONS_CANNOT_FIT even though it was pre-admitted; (9) the single authorized RL trial research-mainline-20261015-6657affa, whose training summary 28663607 was read publicly, terminated interrupted with stop_reason "worker_missing; outstanding reservation conservatively charged", 1200 active seconds charged but zero attempted actions, zero completed actions, zero attempted physics steps, zero complete and zero failed episodes, checkpoint null, workers available_rows 0 with no recorded metrics, remaining active_seconds 0, allocation recycling disabled — so no usable checkpoint exists and no independent evaluation can be run, and the summary itself states that task acceptance requires independent evaluation and that reward is training-only. Both selection candidates offered by the study are ineligible: ca6789a8 because it did not pass a complete task evaluation and requires a new construction, 3bfd4da5 because it did not pass a complete task evaluation. The mathematical side evidence this study holds and the historical passing evidence (compliant distal1 young_pa 4.86e6 with 2/2 fresh non-timed confirmations in study feedback-design-20261014, alongside the retained timed-policy holding-speed failure of a section-scaled candidate) are by the study's own rules not acceptance evidence and cannot satisfy selection.
decisions.interpretation: Seal with no selection and no claim. This study produced no fresh complete passing evaluation, so it establishes nothing about task success, holding, damping, structural superiority, robustness, hardware behaviour, real-time capability, global optimality or repeatability; repeatability was not assessed and repetitions were not_required (required confirmations 0, extra confirmations 0, freezes 0). The reference design's internal evaluation (position_error 0.00312 m, task_success true) is recorded as suggestive but inadmissible, never as a result: a package that fails its own packaging stage cannot be selected, confirmed, or cited as acceptance, and neither a Gramian eigenvalue of 124.5 nor a 1e-9 m class static equilibrium residual is a damping or holding certificate. The unfinished conditions are engineering rather than scientific: a reporting defect (control.profile_report: "name 'report_configuration' is not defined") that stamps completed executions incomplete; a construction-profile rule that refuses both pre-existing study candidates and demands a new construction; a budget-fit rule that then refused that new construction; and a worker loss that consumed the only RL trial with zero recorded actions and no checkpoint. Nothing was retried unchanged, every failure and cost is retained, and no ceiling was treated as a target.
decisions.stopping_condition: Sealed now: no further provider requests, executions, searches, training runs, diagnoses or confirmations; no unchanged-science repetition; no reopening; no extra confirmation. The study ends with both offered selection candidates ineligible, no admissible passing execution, no RL checkpoint, an explicit stop decision on the RL route, and all cumulative costs as recorded.
